body:
## Parent

https://github.com/pane-app/pane/issues/127 (Extension updates)

## What to build

A **Check for Extension Updates** command appears in root search, and the Extensions group in Settings gains a **Check for updates** button beside "Update extensions automatically", with "Last checked …" under it. Both start the same pass at once, whatever the cadence (the updater's existing "check now").

A pass the user asked for includes every installed npm package that is not pinned, every tracked Git package and every default extension, whether or not its automatic updates are turned off, and also disabled and paused ones, since the user asked: an update keeps a disabled package disabled, and an update of a paused package unpauses it, as the preview's Update row already does. Pinned versions, pinned Git revisions, local folders and development copies are listed as Skipped with their reason. Checks run a few packages at a time (about four), each bounded by Pane's existing HTTP limits; staging and applying follow the existing path, so a package in use is applied when it becomes quiet and is listed as "Waiting until <title> is not in use" until then.

Progress shows as one toast that the pass updates — "Checking for extension updates…", "Updating 2 of 3…" — ending as success ("Updated 3 extensions", "Extensions are up to date") or failure ("Updated 2, 1 failed") with a **View Details** action opening the results view; until the toast surface can carry it, the status line carries the same text. **Retry** on a Failed row checks that package alone; **Update Now** on a Skipped row whose only reason is the user's switch updates it.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The command appears in root search and the button appears in the Extensions group in Settings, with "Last checked …"; both start a pass at once
- [ ] A user-asked pass includes turned-off, disabled and paused packages, and skips pinned, local and development copies with their reasons
- [ ] An update keeps a disabled package disabled and unpauses a paused one
- [ ] The progress toast updates through the pass and ends with a summary carrying View Details, which opens the results view
- [ ] A package in use waits and is listed as waiting until it is quiet
- [ ] Retry checks one package alone; Update Now updates a package skipped only for the user's switch
- [ ] Launcher public-interface tests against controlled loopback sources, and window tests with real key events, cover both entry points and the toast's progression

## Blocked by

- #256 — Record update results, show them, and announce background failures
